name: gram-lang
description: Syntax highlighting and language intelligence for Gram recipe files
author: gram-lang

commands.title: Gram: Gantt Chart (deprecated, opens the run sheet)

gram.ingredientDatabase.path.description: Path to a YAML ingredient database file. Leave empty to auto-detect .gram/ingredients.yaml in the workspace root.

enumDescriptions: Each section's mise en place happens right before that section.
All the mise en place happens at the start of the recipe.
The mise en place of each working day happens at the start of that day (days come from the sections' ~{-Nd} anchors).
gram.miseEnPlace.description: When the mise en place (gathering and preparing ingredients and cookware) is planned. Drives the total time in the preview, the run sheet and the title hint.

enumDescriptions: A rest written as a range (~_{12-24h}) lasts the shortest of it: ready as early as it can be.
A rest written as a range lasts the middle of it.
A rest written as a range lasts the longest of it.
gram.rests.description: How long a rest written as a range lasts. An exact rest and an active timer (~{20-25min}, planned on its longest figure) are not affected. Drives the total time in the preview, the run sheet and the title hint.

enumDescriptions: The comments of the recipe (// like this) are shown in the preview and the run sheet, discreetly in the run sheet.
The comments of the recipe are left out of the preview and the run sheet.
gram.comments.description: Whether the preview and the run sheet show the comments of the recipe: the notes alone on a line and the ones at the end of a line.

enumDescriptions: Per 100 g and per portion side by side, with the whole recipe under them.
Always per portion (the whole recipe when the recipe declares no portions).
gram.nutritionBasis.description: Which nutrition basis the preview shows. With auto, per 100 g and per portion side by side; any other value pins one.

gram.bakersMathOnly.description: Show only the baker's percentages in the preview, without the weights.

enumDescriptions: The quantity of each ingredient is written in the text of the steps, after its name.
The steps name the ingredients only; their quantities stay in the ingredient lists and in the tooltip.
gram.stepQuantities.description: Whether the preview writes the quantities of the ingredients in the text of the steps.

gram.bakersMath.description: Compute the baker's percentages, from the ingredient marked with * in the recipe.

gram.massStandardization.description: Convert the quantities to grams with the ingredient database.

gram.yieldCalculation.description: Account for the part of an ingredient lost when it is prepared (peel, stones), so the weight to buy differs from the weight used.

gram.nutritionEstimation.description: Estimate the nutrition of the recipe from the ingredient database.

scripts.package: bunx turbo run build --filter=gram-lang && vsce package --no-dependencies
